contributions.detail: NO FIGURE EXISTS TO RECONCILE AGAINST, so no verdict is claimed and no mismatch is fabricated. The cover's contribution row is verified genuinely EMPTY, the contribution schedule prints no total box, and the schedule carries no transactions: its only printed line is the blank form's SPECIMEN row ('8/25/10 Jon and Jane Doe, PO Box 128, Coalville UT 84017, $435.00'), dropped. The filer's one affirmative mark is a hand-drawn SLASHED ZERO in the Amount column of the row below the specimen (p2 band 3), which under the zero-glyph ruling denotes 0. The side is therefore 'transcribed' with ZERO rows - the schedule exists and is blank of transactions - but nothing is promoted to a stated total.

expenditures.detail: exact - the single handwritten row (7/25/2018, filing fee, 293.54) reproduces the module's stated cover figure to the cent. The page's own total box was left EMPTY by the filer, so the cover is the only printed gate. The printed specimen row ($512.00) is dropped and the gate closing only without it is the proof.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: p2 'Campaign Finacial Report 2018 / ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT' prints NO total box, and the COVER states no contribution figure, so there is NOTHING to gate this side on; the page holds only the blank form's printed SPECIMEN row plus a hand-drawn slashed zero. p3 ITEMIZED EXPENSE REPORT: the printed 'Total amount of expenditures' box is EMPTY, so the only gate is the cover's $293.54 - and the single handwritten row is $293.54, exact. Dropping the printed specimen is what makes the gate close (293.54 + 512.00 = 805.54 is stated nowhere).

_meta_itemized.notes: RE-FILE: Rhonda Francis's Post-Election report reproduces her Pre-Election filing 8196 UNCHANGED - the same two schedule sheets with the same untouched printed specimen rows, the same single handwritten filing-fee line, the same slashed zero, and the same empty expenditure total box; the cover likewise restates $293.54 with no contribution figure. THE COVER STATES NO CONTRIBUTION TOTAL AT ALL, so the contribution side has no gate. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN on p3: columns are assignable but the filer misused one - 'filing fee' (a purpose) is written in the 'Person or Organization' column while the 'Purpose of Expenditure' cell holds only a long hand-drawn horizontal dash; transcribed exactly where written, never moved, and the dash left BLANK as a nil mark.
